row.evidence: Roam Research's pricing page, help graph and developer docs render only inside its JavaScript app and could not be loaded, so no plan, SSO or SCIM fact could be verified; Okta and Microsoft Learn have no Roam app.
row.notes: New row. Roam Research is a single-page JS app: roamresearch.com, the pricing view, the help graph and the developer documentation all render client-side, render.cjs fails on the host (ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES) and curl/WebFetch get only the app shell. The compiled app bundle (js/compiled/main.js) appears to list only individual Professional and Believer subscriptions and contains no 'SCIM' string (its 'SAML' strings belong to the bundled Firebase auth library), but bundle text cannot be quote-checked, so no plan is recorded. Okta and Microsoft Learn have no Roam app (404). Kept as unknown because the help centre and API docs could not be searched (rule 5); likely none.

scim.notes: No SCIM, SAML or admin-console documentation could be read: the site, pricing page, help graph and developer docs are all inside the JS app. The compiled app bundle has no 'SCIM' string; its 'SAML' strings belong to the bundled Firebase auth library.

user_api.notes: Roam documents a graph (backend) API inside its app, which could not be loaded; no user-management API was found.

fallbacks.notes: docs_public left null: the help and developer docs only render inside the JS app and could not be read.
